use_lvmpolld.description: Enable or disable the lvmpolld background daemon. Required for long-running operations like pvmove and RAID sync to run without blocking.

lvmpolld_socket.description: Path to the Unix domain socket used by lvmpolld to communicate with LVM clients.

lvmpolld_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for lvmpolld to respond before aborting the operation.

log_lvmpolld.description: Whether to log lvmpolld activity (start, stop, failures) to syslog.

lvmpolld_polling_interval.description: Interval in seconds between health checks for long-running LVM operations.

lvmpolld_limits.description: Ulimit-style resource limits for the lvmpolld process. Keys are limit names (e.g., 'memlock', 'nofile'), values are integers or 'unlimited'.

items.description: Value for a given resource limit.

prefer_metadata_areas.description: Preferred device metadata area selection policy: 'none' (default), 'first', 'last', 'largest'.

devicesfile.description: Optional path to a file containing a list of devices to scan. Empty = scan all devices.

scan_list.description: Explicit list of device paths to scan. If non-empty, only these devices will be considered.

device_filter.description: List of regex patterns to include/exclude devices during scanning. Patterns starting with 'r' are rejected, 'a' are accepted.

dmfile.description: Optional path to a file containing device-mapper UUIDs to exclude from scanning.

scan_loop_devices.description: Enable or disable scanning of loop devices. Set to true only if you use LVM on loop-backed files.

log_syslog.description: Whether to send LVM log messages to syslog.

log_file.description: Optional path to a log file. Empty disables file logging.

log_overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite previous log files on rotation. If false, old logs are archived with .1, .2, etc.

log_levels.description: List of character flags indicating which log categories to include: d=debug, i=info, n=notify, a=alert, c=control, e=error, f=fatal, o=operations, r=report, s=selection, t=transaction, u=util, v=verbose, x=internal.

activation_monitoring.description: Enable monitoring of activation events — required for lvmpolld to track progress of background operations.

min_recovery_rate.description: Minimum number of sectors per second that RAID or mirror devices must recover to avoid being suspended. Set to 0 to disable.

parallel_activation.description: Maximum number of LVs to activate in parallel. 0 = use system defaults (often CPU count).

background_activation.description: Enable background activation of LVs (e.g., for thin pool creation or RAID init). Required for lvmpolld to track long-running activation tasks.
